item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 15/May/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The trough of low pressure lingering over the northern part of the South China Sea will depart from the region gradually today, but it will also bring showers to the coast of Guangdong at first. Meanwhile, a surge of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong today. It will be windy with temperatures falling progressively over the region. Under the influence of the associated relatively dry continental airstream, the weather will improve over southern China midweek this week. Another broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week.

Weather: Cloudy with a few showers. Visibility relatively low in some areas. Temperatures will fall progressively.

PSR: Medium Low
